I didn't edit anything in the repo. Scripts are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/8d80c188-0981-544b-8b2d-c9de04f0705c/scratchpad/review3/. capture.py wraps S.match_pfr to record what goes in and comes out, and an1-an25.py plus settle.py do the analysis.

1) pfr_franchise is correct for 1970-2021. I checked every code by season: HOU is 1970-96 -> TEN and 2002-21 -> HOU, and there are no HOU rows in 1997-2001. STL is 1970-87 -> ARI and 1995-2015 -> LAR. BAL is 1970-83 -> IND and 1996-2021 -> BAL. OAK, RAI and LVR (2020-21) -> LV. SDG -> LAC, and LAC is 2017+. RAM and LAR -> LAR. Each season has 31 franchises in 1999-2001 and 32 from 2002, and no two codes map to one franchise in a season. PFR and nflverse team yard totals agree; the only gaps come from traded players, whose 2TM rows carry no team.

2) Register matches, 1999-2021: 12,428 single-team PFR rows are applied. None differs in yards from its nflverse stint, apart from nflverse's own gaps in 1999-2000 (Scott Mitchell 1999, Sylvester Morris 2000). The 304 matched 2TM rows all equal the sum of the player's nflverse stints. One id gets two PFR rows (Buddy Howell 2018, 0 yards).

3) The yards fallback made 119 matches and I read every one. All are the right player: Ben/Benjamin Watson, Beanie/Chris Wells, Michael/Mike Vick, Rocket/Raghib Ismail and the rest. It made no false matches.

4) Starters' one-team seasons that still lack PFR's row: only the cases in defects 2 and 3 below.

5) settle_ids: 15 rows change in 1970-98 and 4 in 2021-and-earlier. No id holds rows whose PFR birth years differ by 2 or more. Only one id holds two rows in a season: Steve Griffin, ATL 1987 (GRI320892 + pfr:steve griffin:1964, 4+2 games, 0 yards), which is negligible. The per-team splits are right for Keith Jones 1989 (two different backs). They wrongly split one player in two cases, both negligible: Dave Smith PIT 1970-71 vs KC 1973 (2 games), and Chris Givens. Separately, the register id WIL407427 merges GB-1993's Kevin Williams (3 games, 0 yards) with the Cowboys receiver.

Outside my check, for whoever reviews games played: a traded season is only ever cut down to PFR's combined games, never raised. 174 traded seasons differ from PFR's combined games, for example Matt Flynn 2013 (7 vs 9), Jermaine Wiggins 2000 (10 vs 15), and Matt Cassel 2015 (8 vs 10; he has one nflverse stint, so the 2TM row is never used).

defects.title: Careers split at 1998/1999 for names the register can't place: one player becomes two pids, even twice in the same cell
defects.evidence: match_pfr links PFR stand-in names to nflverse ids by yards, but only for 1999-2021. The same people's 1970-98 rows keep their pfr: stand-in ids, so each career gets two pids. (1) NO-1990 lists the same tight end twice: 'Cam Cleeland' (pfr:cam cleeland:1975; 1998, 16 games, 54-684-6, 42.8 yds/game) and 'Cameron Cleeland' (00-0003103; 1999, 11 games, 26-325-1, 29.5 yds/game). As one line it should be 27 games, 80-1009-7, 37.4 yds/game, and today a lineup can hold both. (2) BAL-1990 'Pat Johnson' (00-0008598) shows 10 games and 52.6 rec yds/game from 1999 alone. His 1998 Ravens season (PFR 'Patrick Johnson', 13 games, 12-159-1) is on pfr:patrick johnson:1976 and isn't listed. Combined it is 23 games, 41-685-4, 29.8 yds/game, so the listed line is about 77% high. (3) Rocket Ismail (pfr:rocket ismail:1969: LV-1990 45 games, CAR-1990 42 games) and Raghib Ismail (00-0008060: DAL-1990 16 games, 68.6 yds/game, rated 18.19; DAL-2000) are one player. Both can be drafted together, and CAR-1990 (rated 11.61, prime None) and LV-1990 (prime CAR-1990) never point to DAL-1990. (4) The MIN-1990 'Matthew Hatchette' line (1997-98, 21 games) leaves out his 1999 Vikings season ('Matt Hatchette' 00-0007103, 13 games, 9-180-2). (5) MIA-1990 'Karim Abdul-Jabbar' (1996-98) and 'Abdul-Karim al-Jabbar' (00-0000003, 1999 MIA/CLE) are split too; his 1999 PFR row is 2TM, so the yards fallback never runs on it. (6) The register gives WIL407427 (born 1970, a 1993-94 entry) to the Cowboys receiver Kevin Williams's PFR rows (born 1971, DAL 1995-96 and BUF 1999), while nflverse has him as 00-0017860 'Kevin R. Williams'. So DAL-1990 'Kevin Williams' and BUF-1990 'Kevin R. Williams' are one person under two pids.
defects.fix: Carry the 1999+ links back to the earlier rows. After match_pfr, map each yards-matched stand-in base id (pfr:name:birth, without any :TEAM suffix) to its nflverse id, and rewrite the 1970-98 rows that hold that stand-in. This means build_nfl_data must apply the mapping to its pfr_rows(1970-1998) output, or verse_rows must return it. Also, for a 1997-98 row whose id never appears in 1999+, merge it into a 1999-2000 nflverse id with the same last name, the same birth year (±1) and the same team in the adjacent season. That covers Cleeland, Johnson, Hatchette and al-Jabbar. Kevin Williams also needs the register id of a pre-99 row and the 1999 PFR row resolved to the nflverse id that holds the same team-season stats.

defects.title: Fallback can't find a player whose nflverse surname differs (Robby Anderson = Robbie Chosen)
defects.evidence: PFR names him 'Robby Anderson' (pfr:robby anderson:1993), and the register has no such name. nflverse uses 'Robbie Chosen' (00-0032688), so the fallback's surname test fails, although yards are identical in all six seasons (2016-21, e.g. 2020 CAR 1096/15, 2017 NYJ 941/9). Without PFR's row, 2016 (where roster counts aren't used) takes his 14 games with a stat instead of PFR's 16. The NYJ-2010 line shows 60 games and 51.0 rec yds/game; PFR has 62 games, 3,059 yards, 49.3 yds/game. Deonte Harris/Harty 2019-21 is missed the same way, but his games already match. Chuck Evans BAL 1999 (PFR 'Charles Evans', 134 rush/235 rec vs nflverse 126/208) fails the 3% tolerance and gets 15 games vs PFR's 16. That case is fringe.
defects.fix: When no player with the same surname matches, also accept an nflverse stint on the same team-season whose three yard columns equal the PFR row's (within a yard or two). Require it to be the only such stint on the team and to have no PFR row yet.

defects.title: A namesake register match bypasses the fallback (Eric Johnson TE, Tony Washington)
defects.evidence: PFR's 49ers tight end Eric Johnson (his age gives born 1976) is register-matched to 00-0018982, a different Eric Johnson born 1976 who has LV and ATL stints. The real tight end, 00-0020455, is born 1979 in the register, so the birth-year test rejects him. His 2001, 2002, 2004, 2006 SF and 2007 NO rows (825 yards in 2004) attach to the wrong id: the team doesn't match, so they're dropped, and the tight end's own seasons get no PFR row. Because the row has a register id, match_pfr never tries the yards fallback on it. His games happen to match PFR's today (16/12/16/13/14), so the numbers aren't wrong yet, but any season where his stat-game count fell below PFR's would be. Tony Washington JAX 2015-16 (00-0031931 instead of 00-0030856, fringe) is the same pattern.
defects.fix: In match_pfr, also run the team + surname + yards fallback for register-matched rows whose id has no nflverse stint on that team-season, and drop the register match when the fallback finds the player.

I ran S.verse_rows, S.pfr_rows(1999-2021) and S.active_games through scripts in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/8d80c188-0981-544b-8b2d-c9de04f0705c/scratchpad/review3/ (dump.py, rawagg.py, a1-a23.py, j1-j4.py). I compared the results with my own counts from the raw wk, rw, games.csv and fdp files. Nothing in the repo was edited.

(1) One-team seasons 1999-2021. Every season that takes PFR's row has g equal to PFR's G (12,587 matched by name and team). Every one-team PFR row with 100+ yards is applied, apart from a few. Robby Anderson (Robbie Chosen in nflverse) is never matched in 2016-21. The Eric Johnson TE rows carry a defender's id, but the games come out equal anyway. Kevin Williams 1999, Charles Evans 1999, Aundrae Allison 2007 and Deonte Harris 2020-21 are also unmatched. To check the ids are right, I compared PFR yards with each player's own nflverse yards. The only differences are the known Jaguars 2001-02 gaps and small 1999-2000 gaps. The HOU (Texans) and LVR team codes now map in every season. In all, 15 one-team seasons have g different from PFR. Most are nicknames under 50 yards that match_pfr skips, plus Robby Anderson.

(2) Traded seasons. Of 304 matched 2TM/3TM seasons, 233 add up exactly to PFR's combined G. One is above: Julius Jones 2010 has 13 against PFR's 12, because nflverse has stat rows in 13 weeks. 70 are below (see defects). No stint is above the games its team played while he was on its roster (weekly rosters, 2002 on).

(3) 2022-2025 non-QB. No stint is above its team's game count. Stars match PFR: McCaffrey 6+11, 16, 4; Adams 17, 17, 3+11; Hopkins 9, 17, 6+11; Amari Cooper 6+8; Kupp 9, 12, 12; Chubb 2 in 2023. The large gaps between active games and stat-row games are all blocking TEs and special teamers. I checked the method on 2020-21 against PFR: 93-94% exact, the rest 1-4 games over, never materially under. Taking the union of stat and active weeks instead of the max changes only 3 single-game cases (2024 week 17 rows marked I01).

(4) 2016-2019 fallback to stat rows. 46 of the 5,323 listed lines include such a season: mostly traded seasons, plus Robbie Chosen x4, Rob Kelley, Jordan Matthews and Raheem Mostert. 13 of them end up with fewer games than PFR has.

defects.title: Traded seasons are only cut down to PFR's combined games, never topped up to it
defects.evidence: In verse_rows, `extra = sum(g) - p['g']` only removes games, through `max(0.0, extra)`. When the stints add up to less than PFR's combined G, nothing is added. 70 of 304 matched traded seasons 1999-2021 stay short: 52 in 1999-2001 and 2016-19, where stints use stat rows; 18 in roster years, through the status bug below. Worst cases: J.P. Holtz 2019 WAS 1 + CHI 7 against PFR 15; Ryan Taylor 2014 GB 1 + CLE 2 against 14; John Phillips 2016 DEN 4 + NO 5 against 16; Luke Stocker 2017 TB 2 + TEN 3 against 12; Mike Davis 2019 CHI 4 + CAR 2 against 12. Provable on a listed line: Mack Hollins 2019. The weekly rosters have him on PHI weeks 1-13 (12 games played) and MIA weeks 14-17 (4 games), which equals PFR's 16. Ours gives PHI 9 + MIA 3, so the PHI-2010 line shows 25 games where it should be 28, and its per-game numbers are 12% too high. Other listed lines short of PFR: Jermaine Wiggins NE-2000 (2000: NYJ 6 + NE 4 against 15), Chad Lewis PHI-1990 (1999: 8 against 12), Marco Battaglia CIN-2000 (2001: 7 against 11), Joique Bell DET-2010 (2016: 3 against 7), A.J. Derby DEN-2010 (2016: 7 against 10), Dontrelle Inman CHI-2010 and LAC-2010 (2017: 10 against 12), Kapri Bibbs WAS-2010, Brice Butler DAL-2010, Rishard Matthews TEN-2010, Bryan Still LAC-1990, and Michael Floyd, Andre Ellington, Zay Jones and Ameer Abdullah (1 game each). All are fringe lines (value about 2-12).
defects.fix: When extra < 0, hand the shortfall out over the stints. Cap each stint at the games its team played in the weeks he was on its roster: weekly rosters from 2002 can show this in any year, 2016-19 included, by roster weeks rather than active flags. For 1999-2001, share it in proportion to the stat-row games.

defects.title: active_games reads 'status == ACT', but in 2002-2015 that column is a season-level transaction status; it also counts duplicate rows
defects.evidence: In the 2002-15 weekly rosters, each week of a season repeats the same status (RES, CUT, TRD, TRC, TRT, DEV, SUS). Whether the player was active that game is in status_description_abbr (A01 or I01). A player who ended the year on injured reserve, or was cut or traded, often has no ACT row at all, so his active count is 0 and he drops back to stat rows. On 2002-15 one-team RB/WR/TE seasons with a PFR row, the current count falls below PFR's G in 5-9% of seasons each year (2005: 8.6%, 2008: 8.4%), which contradicts roster_counts' docstring ('is never lower'). Counting abbr starting with 'A' gives 89-94% exact matches and about 0% below. Examples: Cam Cleeland 2005 LAR has CUT rows with A01 in weeks 5-14 (9 games, PFR 9), but ours is 4 (stat rows), so the listed LAR-2000 line shows 36 games instead of 41. Ryan Taylor 2014 has A01 for GB weeks 1-5 and CLE weeks 9-16, but every row is CUT/TRC/TRT, so he gets 3 games against PFR's 14. Sean Bennett 2002 NYG: 6 against 7. The function also adds 1 per row, not per distinct week. The 2002-11 files have duplicate ACT rows, so Thomas Jones gets 32 'active games' in every season 2003-11, as do Fred Taylor (2002, 2003) and Correll Buckhalter (2006, 2010). Today the PFR override hides both problems for one-team seasons. What is left: 27 non-PFR RB/WR/TE stints (one listed line, Cleeland) plus the roster-year traded shortfalls above.
defects.fix: For 2002-2015, count distinct weeks (a set per player, season and team) where status_description_abbr starts with 'A', whatever the status. From 2020 keep status == ACT, since status is per week there (INA marks inactives). Fix the docstring as well.

defects.title: Renamed players and nicknames under 50 yards never match their PFR row
defects.evidence: Robby Anderson is 'Robbie Chosen' in nflverse and the register, so neither the name lookup nor the last-name fallback in match_pfr finds his PFR rows for 2016-21. His 2016 season comes from stat rows: 14 games against PFR's 16. The NYJ-2010 line shows 60 games where PFR's total is 62; 2020-21 come out right from active counts. Nickname rows go the same way because the fallback needs 50+ yards: Jim/Jimmy Kleinsasser 1999 MIN 8 against 13, Matthew/Matt Hatchette 2001 NYJ 7 against 11, Matthew/Matt Dayes 2017 CLE 13 against 16, Johnny/J.J. Huggins 2001 DAL 7 against 10, Eddie/Edwin Watson 1999 PHI 3 against 6, Joshua/Josh Perkins 2016 ATL 6 against 8, David/Dave Williams 2018 JAX 3 against 6. Charles/Chuck Evans 1999 BAL shows 15 against 16 on a listed BAL-1990 line. 13 one-team seasons in all, almost all fringe.
defects.fix: Match PFR rows to nflverse ids through the season rosters' pfr_id or full_name/football_name, which hold old names and nicknames. Or drop the 50-yard floor when last name, team, season and exact yards all agree. A small alias entry (Robby Anderson to 00-0032688) would cover the one listed line.
